days.summary: Most-upvoted papers on Hugging Face Daily Papers.

items.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
items.note: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the seri…

items.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
items.note: AscendGYM provides a benchmark for assessing kernel optimization capabilities on Ascend NPUs using real-workload test cases, two evaluation modes, and a Speedup-Token Score that balances speedup against token cost.

items.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
items.note: When large language models write neural network weights without gradient-based training, they tend to design sparse table or associative-memory models that outperform same-sized Transformers with far fewer parameters and faster GPU inference, though pretrained…

items.title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
items.note: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an …

items.title: Multi-Branch Transformer
items.note: Branching Transformer blocks into parallel parameterized branches, combined with shared KV caching, improves language model quality and inference efficiency compared with standard sequential Transformers.

items.title: TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
items.note: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TC…

items.title: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency
items.note: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. This paper introduce…

items.title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
items.note: Continual recursive self-improvement lets harness optimizers reuse and revise prior edits across changing benchmarks or policy models by storing rationales, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation contexts in a self-improvement memory, improving final …

days.summary: Top-voted papers on Hugging Face Daily Papers today: a fully open model family, harder benchmarks for coding agents, and a new defense against prompt injection.

items.title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
items.note: Six fully open models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B mixture-of-experts. Good for seeing how a whole model family is designed and trained.

items.title: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees
items.note: Realistic software assignments, from clarifying the task to handing it off. Current coding agents complete few of them.

items.title: SPILLWAY: Defending Tool-Using Agents against Prompt Injection
items.note: Separates deciding what an agent may act on from cleaning its inputs, to stop hidden instructions in web pages and documents.

items.title: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
items.note: An AI reviewer trained with reinforcement learning to find soundness problems in research papers.

items.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier
items.note: Feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input. A small change to the standard Transformer that makes training more efficient.

items.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552B Parameters
items.note: Tests whether scaling laws also hold for models that control robots.

items.title: MovieRoll: Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
items.note: Keeps streaming video generation stable well past the length it was trained on.

days.summary: Agents everywhere: robotics roadmaps, memory systems for agents, and faster decoding for vision-language models.

items.title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
items.note: A survey and roadmap for robots driven by a foundation model plus an agent harness. Easy to read as an overview of the field.

items.title: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System
items.note: Long-term memory for LLM agents without fine-tuning. A close relative of retrieval-augmented generation.

items.title: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
items.note: Up to 3.58× faster generation with no loss in output quality, using speculative decoding and sparse attention for long video.

items.title: Loopback Transformer: A Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers
items.note: Reuses the same layers in a loop, with finer control over the updates. Beats standard and looped baselines.

items.title: JVT: Just Video Transformer for pixel-space video diffusion
items.note: Video diffusion straight on pixels, with no autoencoder. A clean, minimal design worth reading after DDPM.

items.title: Mobile AI Factory: Specialized Language Models for Your Phone
items.note: An agent that automatically fine-tunes and quantizes small models to fit a specific phone.
